title: Firebreak
note: Twelve stages are planned. Stages 1 to 3 are playable (0.5.0); later environments follow.

stages.name: River Village
stages.brief: A jungle river town at golden hour. The first staging post.

stages.name: Dune Sea
stages.brief: Open desert and rock canyons at high noon. Convoys crossing the sand.

stages.name: Coral Coast
stages.brief: A quiet bay at golden hour. Gangs on the water, civilians on the shore.

stages.name: Iron Harbour
stages.brief: A rusted industrial port in dirty weather. Cranes, freighters and warehouses.

stages.name: Night Market
stages.brief: A dense old city after dark. Alleys, rooftops and lantern-lit stalls.

stages.name: High Pass
stages.brief: A snowy mountain border. Switchbacks, a stone fort, a cableway.

stages.name: Broken Dam
stages.brief: A flood-plain below a cracked dam. Catwalks, sluice gates and rushing water.

stages.name: Red Quarry
stages.brief: An open-pit mine. Terraces, trucks and a processing shed.

stages.name: Blackout City
stages.brief: A darkened coastal capital. Street grids and tracer fire in the sky.

stages.name: Honour Gate
stages.brief: Hold the ceremonial square and the gate of a freed city.

stages.name: Storm Jetty
stages.brief: A night raid on a hidden dock. The Ring strikes back.

stages.name: Ember Yard
stages.brief: The network's last warehouse yard. A hard last stand.
